name: Agentic DevSecOps Guard
description: Zero-Trust In-Browser Multi-Agent Cloud Security, FinOps Auditor, AI DevSecOps Engineer & Auto-Remediator
author: Muhammad Shehroz Ali

capabilities.name: Multi-Agent Security & FinOps Audit
capabilities.description: Scans Terraform HCL for misconfigurations, hardcoded secrets, IAM wildcards and oversized or untagged resources. Returns a risk score and findings.

capabilities.name: Zero-Trust Auto-Remediation Agent
capabilities.description: Generates hardened Terraform, then re-scans it with a verifier agent. Remote findings are never trusted; the code is always re-audited locally.

capabilities.name: DevSecOps Pipeline Generator
capabilities.description: Returns a GitHub Actions workflow that blocks insecure Terraform (fmt, validate, tfsec, Checkov).
